fact: On 16 December 2025 the Accra High Court convicted Nana Agradaa under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038) for non-consensual sharing of intimate images, fining her GHS12,000 and ordering GHS50,000 compensation.
title: Agradaa fined GHS12K, ordered to Pay GHS50K compensation for showing pastor's nude photos
